paragraphs.text: Melting first, then entry. Come to same-sap in You, bliss-river: may my mind drop in one go this great disaster of difference-dependence. Mine this, not that: on passion-hate’s fetter-hard root, may the axe fall within — certainty of Thee-made oneness. Melt, thought-stain-string; sport, unboltedness, in heart. Bliss-sap-flooded be my knowing-made form.

Then mother, then ripening. Me, wallowing in passion’s world-egg: O Your-love-thought Mother, plump me with sap on sap, that wing-grown I turn sky-goer. May this mind of mine win connoisseurship — savoring Your-foot-thought-nectar-sap’s pith — till sense-poison-clinging hankers no more. By Your-love-sun’s ray-touch may this mind-jewel of mine shed far off passion-kindled fire-sparks.

Then the station, won. In that station may I hymn You ever, full-throated — where Vishnu, Indra, Brahma wait outside. By whirl born of love’s whirl may I see, senses whole: the all-world Shiva-made, all doings worship-made. My mind-lad has wed Your-love-clan’s lady; she has borne him power-sons. Firm-rooted, may she harden the mine-thought.
